name: commit-conventions
description: Always-on commit message format for AI coding agents: write every commit in the Conventional Commits format (<type>(scope): description) with an imperative, <=72-char subject, a body that explains why, and issue/work-item references in the footer. The tracking-item footer syntax is treated as an action rather than a reference: it is used only when the commit delivers that item, and a sigil-free form is used when citing one as provenance.

source.title: Conventional Commits Specification
source.relationship: Authored as a portable baseline pack from the Conventional Commits spec; kept generic so it applies to work and personal repositories. 2026-09-01: ported a Non-Goals cross-reference to the commit-attribution baseline from the sibling es-ai-toolkit pack (was ahead here).
